snippet.title: Metallica - Enter Sandman - Guitar Lesson - Gibson App - Skill Test - Practice Tab
snippet.description:
Enter Sandman
Metallica
Tab lesson 
Practice
Gibson guitar lesson app
By Zoundio
That has 
Pitch Detection 

I’m a guitar
Hobbyist!

Can you beat
My score?
It’s Easy
It’s fun

There is a Gibson App
Group on Facebook now
Run by fans 
You can ask us questions 

https://m.facebook.com/groups/1921178304974675/?ref=share

Tab highway has
Feedback that makes 
Sight reading tabs 
And learning guitar
Loads of fun

I’m playing my
Stranberg Guitar
Boden Essentials 6
In this video

I’m Using IPad Pro
My Guitar is connected 
With Irig HD 2
Using wired headphones
HDMI out to 
Large Monitor that 
Sits on coffee table
Next to couch 
Makes sight reading
New guitar songs 
Full Speed a blast!

Play along
With me
Lets do a joint 
Practice Session

Repeat
Repeat
Repeat
Muscle memory 
Is the goal 

You can see
Notes i get correct
And my score
At the end of video

Currently I’m working
On level intermediate 
In Gibson app

I am seeing
Rapid improvement
Of all my lead Guitar Skills
With Gibson App

Gibson app
Can make your
Guitar sound good
While learning
Which is a
Difficult task
For any app

App Arrangements
Expertly teach 
Lots of lessons 
For all levels

Gibson app is 
Excellent for
Preparing you 
To jam
With backing tracks
I was not seeing
This feature
In similar apps

Also has several 
Innovative 
Digital amp settings

The Finger placement 
Colors are 
EXTREMELY helpful 

Gibson app is available
Phone or tablet
IOS or Android 
Windows not available

Courses divided in perfect chunks
Doesn’t overwhelm memory

Weekly community challenges
Subscription based
Guitar lessons 
No bass, no piano lessons

Guitar is 
My hobby
Links posted
Are not
Commission
Affiliated 

I attempt
To try all
Guitar software
And find the BEST
Features of each 

Find a friend
That is also
Learning guitar
This helps
You learn faster 

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gibson-learn-play-guitar/id1116032929

To make this video 
I use Ipad screen recording

Free I-Movie
To edit video

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/imovie/id377298193

I recommend making
Videos of your 
Guitar practice sessions
This helps you learn faster

It’s very easy to
Make videos with
Gibson app
On phone/tablet
Just press screen record

I use Photoshop Express
For information slides 

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/photoshop-express-photo-editor/id331975235

#entersandman
#guitartutorial 
#skilltest
